jobs.prompt:
Ticket T-8016. PR #265 (T-8015) removed money from the board, project page and Live tab, but its acceptance review found money still rendered elsewhere, and the owner rule is: no money figure anywhere in Swarm Watch until a real billing source exists. Remove EVERY money figure from every Swarm Watch page and API response. Known leftovers: tools/watch-assets/orchestrator-view.js line ~71 (list value today / all time on every orchestrator card, shared by board, project page, Live tab and run page) and its usd() helper; tools/watch-assets/run.js (run inspector: 'Cost' tile ~35, per-lane cost ~37, per-job cost ~66 and ~74, run cap ~35); tools/watch-cli.mjs /api/run is not passed through stripMoney. Also check the per-run Watch page served by tools/watch-server.mjs (/api/snapshot and /events payloads, rendered by tools/watch-assets/app.js and the run-drawer, run-kpis, run-map and run-panels scripts) and strip money there too (apply the existing stripMoney from tools/watch-cli.mjs or an equivalent exported helper at the watch-server payload boundary, including SSE snapshot and delta events). Show token counts and durations where they exist, never money; hide, never show zero. Keep spend files and cap enforcement untouched.
Extend tests/board-no-money.test.mjs: (a) a static scan of EVERY .js file in the board browser scripts folder finds no money output (no usd( helper calls, no '$' + number formatting, no 'list value', 'Billed', 'Cost' tile labels); (b) /api/run, /api/snapshot, an /events snapshot and a delta, built from run data that has costUsd, carry no money key and no '$' + digit string; (c) the existing checks stay. Update any existing test that asserted money in these views or payloads (tests/watch-ui.test.mjs, tests/watch-server.test.mjs, tests/watch-delta.test.mjs, tests/watch-state.test.mjs, tests/board-page.test.mjs ...) by removing only the money assertions, and list each in notes. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files, .github, tools/board-data.mjs or tools/build-progress.mjs. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-no-money.test.mjs tests/watch-*.test.mjs tests/board-*.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: These tests use the watch server or scripts for unrelated behavior; the coordinator runs the full suite after integration.
